# Load LLM False Belief Data

```{r}
# setwd("/Users/seantrott/Dropbox/UCSD/Research/NLMs/epistemology/dev_tom/src/analysis")
# setwd("/Users/pamelariviere/Dropbox/Research/projects/dev_tom/src/analysis")

# Grab data for false belief task
directory_path <- "../../data/processed/fb_final_stages/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))
df_all_models <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(model_shorthand = str_to_title(model_shorthand))
nrow(df_all_models)

 

df_all_models = df_all_models %>%
  mutate(correct = case_when(
    condition == "False Belief" & log_odds > 0 ~ TRUE,
    condition == "True Belief" & log_odds <= 0 ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE  # all other cases are incorrect
  ))

```

## Process data

```{r}
### Process data
# Create a clean stage label and ordering
df_plot <- df_all_models %>%
  mutate(
    # Identify model family (size)
    model_size = case_when(
      str_detect(model_shorthand, "1b") ~ "1B",
      str_detect(model_shorthand, "7b") ~ "7B",
      str_detect(model_shorthand, "13b") ~ "13B"
    ),
    # Create clean stage labels for plotting
    stage_label = case_when(
      stage == "stage1" ~ "Stage 1",
      stage == "stage2" ~ "Stage 2",
      is.na(stage) & str_detect(model_shorthand, "Sft") ~ "SFT",
      is.na(stage) & str_detect(model_shorthand, "Dpo") ~ "DPO",
      is.na(stage) & str_detect(model_shorthand, "Instruct") ~ "Instruct",
      # The base model (no stage, no SFT/DPO/Instruct suffix) = final pretrained
      TRUE ~ "Pretrained"
    )
  ) %>%
  # Set the stage ordering
  mutate(
    stage_label = factor(stage_label, levels = c(
      "Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Pretrained", "SFT", "DPO", "Instruct"
    ))
  )

```


# Visualization and analysis

## Log odds by stage and step

```{r log_odds}
df_summary_lo <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(model_size, stage_label, condition, knowledge_cue) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_lo = mean(log_odds, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(log_odds, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(model_size = factor(model_size, levels = c("1B", "7B", "13B")))

ggplot(df_summary_lo, aes(x = stage_label, y = mean_lo,
                           color = condition, group = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_lo - 1.96 * se, ymax = mean_lo + 1.96 * se),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(knowledge_cue ~ model_size) +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "magma",
                                                    begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  labs(
    x = "Training Stage",
    y = "Mean Log Odds",
    color = "Condition",
    title = "Log Odds Across Training Stages by Knowledge Cue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  )

```


## Accuracy by stage and step

```{r accuracy}
df_summary <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(model_size, stage_label, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se = sqrt(accuracy * (1 - accuracy) / n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
df_summary <- df_summary %>%
  mutate(model_size = factor(model_size, levels = c("1B", "7B", "13B")))


ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = stage_label, y = accuracy, 
                             color = condition, group = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = accuracy - 1.96 * se, ymax = accuracy + 1.96 * se),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ model_size, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Training Stage",
    y = "Accuracy",
    color = "Condition",
    title = "False Belief Task Accuracy Across OLMo 2 Training Stages"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "magma", 
                                                begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  )
```
